# Assessment Overview

This directory contains supplementary assessment artifacts generated for the PhotoAlbum report. Use the links below to navigate to the available fact documents.

- [architecture-diagram.md](./architecture-diagram.md) — High-level application architecture and detailed component relationship diagrams.
- [dependency-map.md](./dependency-map.md) — External dependency inventory grouped by functional category, including test-only packages.
- [api-service-contracts.md](./api-service-contracts.md) — HTTP surface, page handler contracts, and synchronous request flow documentation.
- [data-architecture.md](./data-architecture.md) — Database configuration, persistence model, and data sensitivity notes.
- [configuration-inventory.md](./configuration-inventory.md) — Externalized settings, runtime profiles, secret references, and framework versions.
- [business-workflows.md](./business-workflows.md) — Core user workflows, business rules, and the main upload sequence.
